signed_rows.behavior: kmctl new writes stale_after as a UTC timestamp from a duration (30d, 12w, 6m, 1y) or a date, for every kind, and a handoff's --stale-after replaces its 14-day default.
signed_rows.fails_when: for any kind or any of those forms the written stale_after is missing or not the expected UTC time, or a handoff given --stale-after still gets the 14-day default

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl new refuses a past date or an unparseable --stale-after with a message naming the value, writing nothing.
signed_rows.fails_when: a past date or a value like 'soon' or '30x' is accepted, the message does not name the value, or any file is written

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl new writes every --source path, in order, as resource mappings, accepts an existing file git does not track yet, refuses a path that does not exist (naming it) and refuses --source on a handoff; kmctl review due lists the concept as due after a commit that changes a source.
signed_rows.fails_when: the sources list is missing a path, out of order, or not resource mappings; an existing untracked file is refused; a missing path is accepted or not named; a handoff accepts --source; or after verifying the concept and committing a change to its source, review due does not list it with the source-changed reason

signed_rows.behavior: Front matter written with both options passes the strict okf validator and the I4 written-fields test.
signed_rows.fails_when: okf_validate --strict fails on a bundle with such concepts, or tests/test_okf_fields.py fails
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_new_concept.py -k freshness_valid tests/test_okf_fields.py -q

signed_rows.behavior: The kmctl block's duties tell agents to name the code a concept describes with --source and to give anything time-bound a --stale-after; kmctl new --help and the reference describe both options.
signed_rows.fails_when: the block written by kmctl init lacks either option, or kmctl new decision --help or docs/reference/commands.md does not describe both
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_init.py -k block_names_freshness tests/test_new_concept.py -k freshness_documented -q

resigns.reason: plan round 1 review: sources must exist on disk (as review due resolves them), not be tracked; --source refused on handoffs
